first_text: Supplementary Fig. 1. The various clinical manifestations exhibited by the dogs included in the present study were the pale (a), congested (b), and icteric (c) mucous membranes, melena (d), severe tick infestation (e), petechial haemorrhages on mucous membranes, and blood red coloured urine before centrifugation (g, h). The red colour of supernatant after centrifuging urine at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes indicated haemoglobinuria.
